blocks.text: Module test B2.3 · Translation
Instructions

Week 223 of the calendar, after verification of B2-13 → B2-16 (and, for varieties, of EGY-16 and EGY-17; EGY-18 is in progress and does not enter the test). Duration: approx. 130 minutes for parts A/E, plus 15 minutes of interview with the tutor. Work without notes; the dictionary (by root or bilingual) is allowed only in parts D and E (translations). Fix it with the solution. Part B scripts are at the beginning of solutions: make them read to another person (the song 3 to an Egyptian speaker) or use vocal synthesis for songs in fuṣḥā, without reading them. The texts of parts A and D are without vowels.

rows: Reading: An article with different sources, ambiguous words and translation problems
Listening: a newscast, an interview with an interpreter, an Egyptian podcast
Language: ambiguity without vowels, translation to Arabic, casts, titles, Egyptian media
Oral production: visual translation in the two senses, Egyptian (heading)

blocks.text: Total 50

Overcoming. At least 38 points above 50 and at least 3 on 4 in each criterion of headings (parts D, E, F); for the criterion "Correctivity of Arabic" in Part E sufficient 2 on 4 (the 3 is the end target B2, the 4 of C1). If you do not pass the test, review the weaker unit during B2-17 and repeat the tutor test within the week 225. Reading speed (does not enter the score). Before answering the questions in part A, read the text once silently with the stopwatch and note the time: the text has about 330 words. Objective at this point of the course: 88 words per minute (90 at the end of the level).
A · Reading (10 points)
Country, people, figures and invented stories.

⁧العامين المقبلين، بعد أن كشف تقرير رسمي أن عددا كبيرا من القضايا يؤجل بسبب غياب المترجمين.⁩
⁧وبحسب التقرير، الذي نشر الأسبوع الماضي، فإن المحاكم تحتاج إلى مترجمين في أكثر من ثلاثين لغة،⁩

2. Reassume the position of the minister, union and teacher, indicating for each the verb of Attribution and what it adds (B2-08).

B · Listening (6 points)
Listen to each song twice, with 30 Second pause. Answer in English; 2 points per song.
1. A news report. What was inaugurated, where and with what numbers? Translate in writing the first sentence of News.
2. An interview with an interpreter. What makes the interpreter more difficult, and why? What advice does it give to those who Are you going to start?
3. An Egyptian podcast. What is the conductor talking about? What happened to him, and what did he learn?
Transcribe two discursive signals that you hear and explain the function (EGY-17).
C · Language (10 points)
One point for an answer. Write with the vowels where you need it.

Translate into a natural journalistic Italian (about 140 words). Dictionary admitted.

⁧افتتح وزير الثقافة أمس الدورة العشرين لمعرض الكتاب الدولي، بمشاركة أكثر من خمسمئة دار نشر من⁩
⁧لم يعد مجرد سوق للكتب، بل أصبح موعدا ثقافيا⁩ » ⁧ثلاثين دولة. وقال الوزير في كلمة الافتتاح إن المعرض⁩
⁧، معربا عن أمله في أن يتجاوز عدد الزوار مليون زائر.⁩ « ⁧ينتظره القراء من عام إلى عام⁩
⁧ويخصص المعرض هذا العام جناحا للترجمة، يضم ندوات عن ترجمة الأدب العربي إلى اللغات الأوروبية،⁩
⁧وورشات للمترجمين الشباب. وكانت إدارة المعرض قد أعلنت أن الدخول سيكون مجانيا للطلاب والأطفال.⁩

⁧ومن المقرر أن يستمر المعرض حتى نهاية الشهر.⁩ .« ⁧المشاركة⁩

E · Translation from English to Arabic (8 points)

Translate this invented news (about 90 words). Dictionary admitted. Then he vocalizes at most four words that an Arabic reader could read in two ways. The city of Milan presented yesterday a plan to make libraries more accessible. From next month twelve libraries will remain open until 22, and three of them also on Sundays. "Libraries are the squares of the future," said the city councilman to culture, adding that the plan will cost two million euros. Some librarians, however, have asked for new recruits, because the current staff "is not enough." The plan is expected to enter into force in March. ⁧أَمِينُ مَكْتَبَةٍ⁩ (pl. ⁧أُمَنَاءُ مَكْتَبَاتٍ⁩ ) Librarian ⁧تَوْظِيف⁩ • recruitment • recruitment • recruitment • recruitment Evaluation: Accuracy 1–4 + Arabic correctness 1–4 (B2-15); the choice of vocalized words enters the Correctness.
F · Oral production (8 points)
With the tutor, about 15 minutes. The tutor texts are in the solutions.

1. Visible translation to Italian (5 minutes). The tutor gives you a short word without vowels; you have one minute to Read it in silence, then translate it into natural English. The tutor asks you to explain the reading of two ambiguous words.
2. Visible translation to Arabic (4 minutes). The tutor reads five short Italian sentences (a warning and a news); You translate them into Arabic.

3. Egyptian (6 minutes). The tutor reads a podcast piece of about 40 second: summarize it in English and propose to voice two subtitles (EGY-17). Then the tutor presents you with two situations in Egyptian: answer with the appropriate formulas (EGY-16). Evaluation: Accuracy 1–4 + Fluidity and interaction 1–4. Part F assesses the tutor; Without tutors, it remains unfinished.
